notes: v1.2.9 stabilization: fixes backend/frontend version drift and adds build-time version consistency validation.
Update banner View Update now deep-links directly to Settings → Updates.
Updater reconnect detection now allows five minutes, reconciles the installed version before declaring failure, and avoids false-negative timeout messaging.
Restores professional built-in SVG iconography across navigation, dashboard KPIs, insights, and firearm card indicators.
Fixes cartridge assets in production by copying the complete Vite dist, including public cartridge files; replaces generic cartridge silhouettes with caliber-specific raster artwork.
Removes floating firearm gallery actions; photo primary/delete actions now live in a menu on the gallery image.
Restores Reset Colors and Reset All Appearance controls.
Dashboard firearm cards open the selected firearm directly; Reserve by Caliber rows open Ammunition prefiltered to that caliber.
Ammunition KPI row now emphasizes rounds on hand, total reserve coverage, caliber target status, and container count.
Hardens bundled cartridge image filenames for Windows/ZIP/build compatibility by removing leading dots from asset filenames while preserving caliber display names.
